title_jp: {町|まち}の{写真|しゃしん}クラブ
context: Thursday 26 November, evening at the {田中|たなか} house: under the kotatsu アルちゃん reads the town newsletter's page on the local photo club. It says film cameras are popular with young people again, and he thinks of レン.
scene: Thursday night under the kotatsu. The town newsletter has a page on the local photo club, and it mentions film cameras: レン's hobby.
text_title: {町報|ちょうほう|town newsletter|2}たかのはら 12{月号|がつごう}：サークル{紹介|しょうかい|introduction|4}

phrases.jp: {写真|しゃしん}について、もっと{知りたい|しりたい}です。
phrases.en: I'd like to know more about photography.
phrases.note: Noun + について = about. Works with {知|し}る, {話|はな}す, {聞|き}く, {調|しら}べる.

phrases.jp: フィルムカメラ、{若い|わかい}{人|ひと}に{人気|にんき}らしいよ。
phrases.en: Apparently film cameras are popular with young people.
phrases.note: らしい passes on something you read or heard, a little less sure than そうだ.

phrases.jp: {代表|だいひょう|representative, leader|3}の{方|かた}によると、{初心者|しょしんしゃ|beginner|3}でも{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}だそうです。
phrases.en: According to the leader, even beginners are fine.
phrases.note: 〜によると…そうです: name the source, then the news. Very common in polite talk.

phrases.jp: {何|なに}かに{夢中|むちゅう|absorbed, crazy about|3}になれる{趣味|しゅみ|hobby|4}がほしいな。
phrases.en: I want a hobby I can really get lost in.
phrases.note: 〜に{夢中|むちゅう}になる = to get hooked on something.

phrases.jp: すみません、{写真|しゃしん}を{撮って|とって|to take (a photo)|4}もいいですか。
phrases.en: Excuse me, may I take a photo?
phrases.note: Ask this before photographing people, shops or inside temples.

dialogue_setting: The December issue of the town newsletter, left on the kotatsu by {恵子|けいこ}さん.

dialogue.speaker: This month
dialogue.jp: {今月|こんげつ}は、{町|まち}の{写真|しゃしん}クラブについて{紹介|しょうかい|introduction|4}します。{名前|なまえ}は「{鷹ノ原|たかのはら}フォト{会|かい|club, society|3}」です。
dialogue.en: This month we introduce the town's photo club. Its name is '{鷹ノ原|たかのはら}フォト{会|かい}'.

dialogue.speaker: Members
dialogue.jp: {会員|かいいん|member (of a club)|3}は20{代|だい}から80{代|だい}まで15{人|にん}。{毎月|まいつき}{第2日曜日|だいににちようび|second Sunday (of the month)|2}に{公民館|こうみんかん|community hall|3}に{集まって|あつまって|to gather|4}います。
dialogue.en: There are 15 members, from their 20s to their 80s. They meet at the community hall on the second Sunday of every month.

dialogue.speaker: Winter
dialogue.jp: {会員|かいいん|member (of a club)|3}の{話|はなし}によると、{冬|ふゆ}は{公民館|こうみんかん|community hall|3}の{窓|まど}から{鷹見岳|たかみだけ}がきれいに{撮れる|とれる|can take (a photo)|4}そうです。
dialogue.en: According to the members, in winter you can get a beautiful shot of {鷹見岳|たかみだけ} from the community hall's window.

dialogue.speaker: Trend
dialogue.jp: {最近|さいきん}は、{若い|わかい}{人|ひと}の{間|あいだ|among|3}でフィルムカメラが{人気|にんき}らしいです。{現像|げんぞう|developing (film)|2}を{待つ|まつ}のも{楽しい|たのしい}そうです。
dialogue.en: Lately film cameras seem to be popular among young people. Apparently waiting for the film to be developed is part of the fun.

dialogue.speaker: The leader
dialogue.jp: {代表|だいひょう|representative, leader|3}の{山田|やまだ}さん（72）は「{写真|しゃしん}に{夢中|むちゅう|absorbed, crazy about|3}になって、{毎日|まいにち}が{楽しく|たのしく}なった」と{話して|はなして}いました。
dialogue.en: The leader, {山田|やまだ}さん (72), said, 'Since I got hooked on photography, every day has become fun.'

dialogue.speaker: Join us
dialogue.jp: {初心者|しょしんしゃ|beginner|3}{歓迎|かんげい|welcome|3}！{道具|どうぐ|tools, equipment|3}がない{人|ひと}は、スマホでも{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}です。
dialogue.en: Beginners welcome! If you have no equipment, a smartphone is fine too.

dialogue.speaker: Contact
dialogue.jp: {写真|しゃしん}について{質問|しつもん}がある{方|かた}は、{気軽|きがる|feel free, casually|3}に{公民館|こうみんかん|community hall|3}までどうぞ。
dialogue.en: If you have any questions about photography, feel free to come to the community hall.

listening.intro: You send レン a photo of the page. He answers with a voice message. Type what he says.

lines.jp: フィルムについてなら、{何|なん}でも{聞いて|きいて}ね。
lines.en: If it's about film, ask me anything.

lines.jp: {今度|こんど}、{僕|ぼく}のカメラ{見せる|みせる}よ。
lines.en: I'll show you my camera some time.

grammar.form: noun + について ({写真|しゃしん}について, {日本|にほん}について) · before a noun: noun + についての + noun ({写真|しゃしん}についての{質問|しつもん}, {雪|ゆき}についての{記事|きじ})
grammar.explanation: Marks the topic you talk, ask, think or write about: {写真|しゃしん}について{話|はな}す. Before another noun it needs の: についての{記事|きじ}. Don't confuse it with にとって (for someone, from their point of view) or によって (depending on).

examples.jp: {日本|にほん}の{歴史|れきし|history|4}について、レポートを{書きました|かきました}。
examples.en: I wrote a report about Japanese history.

examples.jp: {好きな|すきな}{映画|えいが}について、{何時間|なんじかん}も{話しちゃった|はなしちゃった}。
examples.en: We ended up talking about our favourite films for hours.

quiz.question: {新しい|あたらしい}{仕事|しごと}＿＿、{何|なに}か{質問|しつもん}はありますか。
quiz.en: Do you have any questions about the new job?
quiz.explain: The topic of the questions → について. にとって = for someone, によって = depending on.

quiz_more.question: これは{雪|ゆき}＿＿{記事|きじ|article|3}です。
quiz_more.en: This is an article about snow.
quiz_more.explain: Before a noun ({記事|きじ}) you need の: についての.

quiz_more.question: {子ども|こども}＿＿、この{本|ほん}は{難しすぎます|むずかしすぎます}。
quiz_more.en: For children, this book is too difficult.
quiz_more.explain: From children's point of view → にとって. について would mean the book is about children.

kanji.where: On the newsletter's little map, and over the door of the building where the photo club meets.
kanji.breakdown: {公民館|こうみんかん}: 公 public + 民 people + 館 building → 'a building for the town's people'.
kanji.related: {図書館|としょかん} = library; {映画館|えいがかん} = cinema: 館 is a building for something.

tip.title: Ask before you shoot
tip.body: In Japan, ask before photographing people: すみません、{写真|しゃしん}を{撮って|とって}もいいですか. Many people don't want their face on social media, so friends often blur faces or shoot from behind. Shrines, museums and shops may have {撮影禁止|さつえいきんし} (no photos) signs.

challenge.prompt: レン on LINE: 「{町報|ちょうほう|town newsletter|2}？どんな{記事|きじ|article|3}？」 You reply that it's an article about the town's photo club, and that film cameras seem to be popular. One part is wrong.

parts.jp: {町|まち}の{写真|しゃしん}クラブ
について{記事|きじ}だよ。
parts.why: Before a noun ({記事|きじ}) について needs の: についての{記事|きじ}.

challenge.model_answer: {町|まち}の{写真|しゃしん}クラブについての{記事|きじ|article|3}だよ。フィルムカメラが{人気|にんき}らしい！
challenge.explanation: についての links the topic to the noun {記事|きじ}: 'an article about the photo club'. らしい passes on what you read, without claiming it yourself. Plain form + よ fits a friendly chat with レン.

vocab.note: {紹介|しょうかい}する = to introduce. {自己紹介|じこしょうかい} = self-introduction.
{会|かい} club + {員|いん} member. Also gym or shop membership: {会員|かいいん}カード.
{集|あつ}まる = people gather; {集|あつ}める = you collect something.
Same sound as {取|と}る, but {撮|と}る is only for photos and video. {撮|と}れる = can take.
{夢|む} dream + {中|ちゅう} inside → lost in a dream. 〜に{夢中|むちゅう}になる.
{初|しょ} first + {心|しん} heart + {者|しゃ} person. The green-yellow car sticker is {初心者|しょしんしゃ}マーク.
On flyers: {初心者|しょしんしゃ}{歓迎|かんげい}. {歓迎会|かんげいかい} = welcome party.
Any gear for a job or hobby: {釣|つ}りの{道具|どうぐ} = fishing gear.
{気軽|きがる}にどうぞ = feel free. Polite and friendly, common on signs and flyers.

kanji_study.parts: 扌 hand radical + 最 most, best → your hand catching the best moment: take a photo.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 最 (most): 撮 is 最 with 扌 hand added on the left.

kanji_study.parts: 穴 hole radical (a roof with an opening) + ム + 心 heart → the opening in your house where your heart looks out: window.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 空 (sky): both start with 穴, but 窓 has ム and 心 below, 空 has 工.

extras.title: Camera talk
extras.title_jp: {写真|しゃしん}の{言葉|ことば}
extras.intro: Words you'll hear from anyone with a camera, film or phone.

items.note: {自|じ} self + {撮|ど}り taking. {自撮|じど}り{棒|ぼう} = selfie stick.

items.jp: {映える|ばえる|(slang) look great in photos|3}
items.en: to look great on social media
items.note: Slang. インスタ{映|ば}え = Insta-worthy. Standard {映|は}える means 'to shine'.
Film shops still offer it; it takes about a week.

items.jp: {撮影禁止|さつえいきんし|no photography|2}
items.note: The sign you'll see in temples, museums and some shops.

extras.title: Three ways to pass on what you heard
extras.title_jp: {聞いた|きいた}{話|はなし}の{伝え方|つたえかた}

items.note: Polite and clear: you're reporting what you heard or read.
Casual, a little less sure, like something you picked up.
Very casual, spoken. Friends use it all the time.
